mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT doctor_name AS doctorName, dept_name AS deptName, NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND doctor_name IS NOT NULL
AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
GROUP BY doctor_name, dept_name ORDER BY remainAlert DESC

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, doctor_name AS doctorName, stat_date AS statDate, clinic_period AS clinicPeriod, his_logout_time AS hisLogoutTime, NVL(remain_alert, 0) AS remainAlert, NVL(appointment_alert, 0) AS appointmentAlert, NVL(early_leave, 0) AS earlyLeave FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND NVL(early_leave, 0) > 0
AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
AND doctor_name LIKE '%' || #{doctorName} || '%'
AND clinic_period LIKE '%' || #{clinicPeriod} || '%'
ORDER BY stat_date DESC, dept_name, doctor_name
